```{=html}
<style>
  .pkg-desc-text {
    font-size: 0.95em; 
    font-family: 'Georgia', serif; 
    max-width: 900px;
    color: #777777; /* 纯正的深灰色，用于默认亮色主题 */
  }
  body.quarto-dark .pkg-desc-text,
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pkg-desc-text {
    color: #cccccc; /* 提亮的浅灰色，用于暗黑主题 */
  }

  /* 取消 Archived 标题默认生成的底边框，由下方的交互线替代 */
  #archived h2, h2#archived {
    border-bottom: none !important;
    margin-bottom: 0 !important;
  }

  /* --- 交互式隐藏分割线统一样式 --- */
  .interactive-divider {
    position: relative;
    background-color: transparent; /* 背景透明 */
    border: 0px solid transparent; 
    border-top: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent); /* 使用半透明边框变量，完美伪装原生的柔和二级横线 */
    margin: 15px 0 35px 0; /* 留出合适的上下间距 */
    transition: background-color 0.4s ease, padding 0.4s ease, border-width 0.4s ease, border-color 0.4s ease, border-radius 0.4s ease;
    border-radius: 0px; /* 初始状态为锋利的直线，无圆角 */
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  /* 暗黑模式下，精准匹配原生二级标题下划线的颜色 */
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .interactive-divider,
  body.quarto-dark .interactive-divider {
    border-top-color: #434343;
  }

  /* 扩大不可见的鼠标触发区域，方便触发 hover */
  .interactive-divider::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: -25px; /* 上下各延伸 25px，创造一个厚达 50px 的隐形触碰区 */
    bottom: -25px;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .interactive-divider:hover {
    background-color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.05); /* 轻微的高亮背景 */
    padding: 25px 30px;
    border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent); /* 展开后的边框也保持柔和的半透明色 */
    border-radius: 8px; /* 展开后平滑浮现出卡片的圆角 */
    cursor: auto;
  }

  /* 暗黑模式下展开的边框颜色也保持一致 */
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .interactive-divider:hover,
  body.quarto-dark .interactive-divider:hover {
    border-color: #434343;
  }

  .interactive-divider .pkg-desc-text {
    position: relative;
    max-height: 0px; /* 将隐藏高度的逻辑转移给内部文本 */
    overflow: hidden; /* 内部文本收缩时自己隐藏，释放外部容器 */
    z-index: 2; /* 确保文字在伪元素之上，防止被遮挡无法选中文字 */
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
    transition: max-height 0.6s ease, opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease; /* 收起时立刻消失 */
    /* 基于窗口大小动态缩放字体：最小 0.8rem，最大 0.95em，中间随屏幕宽度自适应 */
    font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 3.5vw, 0.95em); 
  }

  .interactive-divider:hover .pkg-desc-text {
    max-height: 800px; /* 内部文本展开 */
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
    transition: max-height 0.6s ease, opacity 0.4s ease 0.2s, transform 0.4s ease 0.2s; /* 展开时延迟淡入 */
  }

  /* 针对手机端极窄屏幕优化，留出更多横向空间给文字 */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .interactive-divider:hover {
      padding: 15px 12px;
    }
  }
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const moveDividers = () => {
    const move = (placeholderId, dividerId) => {
      const placeholder = document.getElementById(placeholderId);
      const divider = document.getElementById(dividerId);
      // 将隐藏的描述特效块精确移动到 EJS 模板预留的插槽中
      if (placeholder && divider && placeholder.children.length === 0) {
        placeholder.appendChild(divider);
      }
    };
    move('interactive-divider-active-placeholder', 'interactive-divider-active');
  };
  
  moveDividers();
  // 额外的延迟调用，防止 Quarto 渲染结构较慢
  setTimeout(moveDividers, 150);
  setTimeout(moveDividers, 500);
});
</script>
```

## Active

::: {#list-active}
:::

::: {#interactive-divider-active .interactive-divider}
::: {.pkg-desc-text}

  It is not just from binary to multi, but a universal platform for constructing RL models.

  - **Latent Rule Learning**  
    Supports learning latent rules (cues != responses).

  - **Multiple Cognitive Systems**  
    Supports parallel updating of multiple Q-tables ($Q_{RL}$, $Q_{WM}$, $Q_{..}$).

  - **Flexible Trial-by-Trial Model Construction**  
    Supports infinite parameters and variables.

  - **Multiple Parameter Estimation Methods**  
    Supports MLE, MAP, ABC, and RNN-based estimation approaches.

:::
:::

## Archived {#archived}

::: {#interactive-divider-archived .interactive-divider style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 35px;"}
::: {.pkg-desc-text}
These packages were developed to manage and analyze the large datasets involved in the <a href="projects/2025_ReliabilitySMT.html"><i>Reliability of the Self‑Matching Task</i></a> project. By packaging core functions, they avoid the messiness of traditional procedural scripts, facilitating both smooth project progression and reproducible research.
:::
:::
